integrity: The analytic proof covers all integer n >= 6; exact-fraction collocation and floating-point diagnostics are reproducibility checks and do not substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Classical uniform clamped cubic Schoenberg–Greville operator only, n >= 6. The result determines the largest nontrivial eigenvalue and its asymptotic expansion, not the full spectrum or finite-iterate operator norm. Unindexed older cubic-spline quantization remains a novelty risk.
title: Exact Perron quantization and a boundary correction for cubic Schoenberg averaging
